description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class which provides utility methods for handling JSON objects, specifically for creating, modifying, and querying JSON data related to boolean and string entries. It also includes methods for serializing boolean values to JSON strings.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for manipulating JSON objects, especially for boolean and string data types.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject has a specific key with a boolean value and retrieves that value.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a single boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to an existing JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a specific key with a string value and retrieves that value.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value to a JSON string 'true' or 'false'.
